schema.name: artifact_uses
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_uses (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, artifact TEXT NOT NULL, run TEXT NOT NULL,

schema.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_grants(principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id), project TEXT NOT NULL, task TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', run TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', restricted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,task,run))

schema.name: auth_principals
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE auth_principals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, roles TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(roles)), can_create_project INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: backup_restore_barriers
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE backup_restore_barriers(project TEXT NOT NULL,run TEXT NOT NULL,restored_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(project,run))

schema.name: client_command_queue
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE client_command_queue (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES client_queue_fences(generation), queue_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, accepted_writer_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
 delivery TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery IN ('STEER','FOLLOW_UP')), content TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ENQUEUED','SENDING','SDK_ACCEPTED','CONSUMED','DROP_REQUESTED','DROPPED','UNKNOWN')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_receipt_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,command_id), UNIQUE(generation,queue_sequence)
)

schema.name: client_control_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE client_control_receipts (
 receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL,
 command_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 previous_receipt_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: client_control_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE client_control_requests (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL, control_request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_ids TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('REQUESTED','RECONCILING','CONFIRMED')),
 original_response TEXT, final_response TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,command_id)
)

schema.name: client_queue_fences
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE client_queue_fences (
 project TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('OPEN','SEALING','SEALED','CANCEL_FENCED','RECONCILING')),
 accepted_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sealed_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 run_id TEXT, runtime_epoch INTEGER, dispatch_key TEXT, manifest_hash TEXT, process_identity TEXT,
 restore_fenced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(restore_fenced IN (0,1)),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(project,task_id)
)

schema.name: client_sessions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE client_sessions (
  id                            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision                      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
  created_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  goal_id                       TEXT,
  task_id                       TEXT,
  run_id                        TEXT,
  writer_epoch                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (writer_epoch >= 1),
  writer_client_id              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(writer_client_id) >= 1),
  lease_expires_at              TEXT,
  event_watermark               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_watermark >= 0),
  upstream_session_id           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(upstream_session_id) >= 1),
  upstream_log_id               TEXT,
  upstream_log_hash             TEXT CHECK (upstream_log_hash IS NULL OR (length(upstream_log_hash) = 71 AND upstream_log_hash GLOB 'sha256:[0-9a-f]*')),
  workspace_ref                 TEXT,
  title                         TEXT,
  model_config_ref              TEXT,
  core_build_id                 TEXT,
  transcript_artifact_id        TEXT,
  resume_requires_explicit_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resume_requires_explicit_user IN (0,1)),
  sealed_at                     TEXT,
  archived_at                   TEXT,
  protocol                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'researchos-client/2' CHECK (protocol = 'researchos-client/2')
)

schema.name: consumer_inbox

schema.name: context_projection

schema.name: decision_lineage

schema.name: domain_refs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE domain_refs (

		WHEN NEW.writer_epoch > OLD.writer_epoch

		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects r WHERE r.kind='Run' AND r.project=NEW.project_id AND r.id=NEW.run_id
			AND json_extract(r.body,'$.status') IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','RECONCILING','LOST'))
		AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_observations o
			WHERE o.project=NEW.project_id AND o.run=NEW.run_id
			AND o.observed_at > (SELECT max(b.restored_at) FROM backup_restore_barriers b WHERE b.project=NEW.project_id AND b.run=NEW.run_id)
			AND json_extract(o.body,'$.children_stopped')=1 AND json_extract(o.body,'$.queue_empty')=1)
		BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'RESTORE_FRESH_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'); END

 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable research work mapping') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_receipt IS NOT OLD.source_receipt
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable source receipt') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND (
 json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch')<1
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.project_id') IS NOT NEW.project
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.task_id') IS NOT NEW.task
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.effect_key') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.request_hash') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.manifest_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_before_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_after_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Run' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.run_id') AND json_extract(body,'$.task_id')=NEW.task)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='BudgetLedgerEntry' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id')))
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound source receipt required') END;
END
